(Case 02)2023

Caswino

Crypto casino platform. UX/UI design

Caswino is a crypto-first online casino with thousands of slots, live tables and instant games. The goal of the redesign was to make the product feel premium and fast: find a game in seconds, top up in a couple of taps and always see which bonuses are waiting.

Open in Figma ↗

Role
Product Designer (UX/UI)
Platforms
Desktop · Tablet · Mobile web
Scope
UX flows, UI design, design system, prototypes
Industry
iGaming · Crypto casino

80+

Desktop screens

85+

Mobile screens

3

Breakpoints: 1440 / 1024 / 375

Task

Make a crypto casino with thousands of games feel premium and fast: find a game in seconds, top up in a couple of taps and always see which bonuses are waiting.

Solution

A lobby with category tabs and game rails; a game page with a quick-deposit bar and split-screen mode; a multi-currency wallet for deposits, withdrawals and exchange; a player dashboard with bonuses and bet history — all on one design system.

Result

80+ desktop and 85+ mobile screens across three breakpoints (1440 / 1024 / 375), plus prototypes of the product walkthrough and the mobile version.
